title: Profils comfyui-profiles
description: ComfyUI usage profiles file: models, custom nodes, workflows and pip packages of each use case. Keys starting with // are comments.

variant.description: Variant(s) of the profile this item belongs to (see variants). Without it: common to all the variants.

description.description: Free text, shown in the panel and by `list`.

size.description: Total size, computed by `comfy_profiles.py sizes` (informative); one per variant for a profile with variants.

extends.description: Profiles whose whole content this one includes; name[variant,...] picks variants of a profile with variants (without brackets: its default_variant).

variants.description: Variants of the profile (e.g. int8, fp8, bf16): its items tagged with "variant" belong to these variants only, the others are common to all of them. Installed with name[variant,...].

default_variant.description: Variant installed when the profile is named without brackets. Without it, only the common items are.

file.description: A file to download, from a single source: hf, github, civitai or url.

github.description: Public GitHub repository (owner/repo or its URL), with file. Only the file is downloaded.

civitai.description: VERSION id of a CivitAI model (CIVITAI_TOKEN), with name.

file.description: Path of the file in the repository (hf, github).

name.description: Local file name. Default: the name of file (hf, github).

size.description: Size in bytes, computed by `comfy_profiles.py sizes`.

type.description: Subfolder of models/: checkpoints, loras, vae, diffusion_models, text_encoders... (may contain a subfolder, e.g. diffusion_models/krea2).

gdrive.description: Public zip on Google Drive (share link or id), with name. Encrypted: GDRIVE_ZIP_PASSWORD.

name.description: Folder name in custom_nodes/. Default: the name of the git repository.
